item.title: Top 3 Methods to Implement Autoreload in Gunicorn on Source Change
item.description:
Finally, transitioning your development environment from Django’s built-in runserver to using Gunicorn with Nginx can significantly improve performance for production applications. However, one of the downsides during development is the lack of an automatic reload feature when source files change. This can slow down your workflow, as you are required to manually restart the server frequently.

Is there a straightforward way to mimic the autoreload capabilities you enjoyed with runserver while using Gunicorn? The answer is yes! Below, discover three powerful methods that can enable autoreload functionality with Gunicorn.
